description.text: An open stretch of asphalt fills the view under a low, raking light that skims the surface and picks out every seam and scatter of grit.

The setting is bare and uncluttered, a pale haze above a low horizon, so nothing competes with the car's silhouette. A low, steady engine idle sits under the stillness. As the shot settles, the front quarter grows legible: the weave of the carbon fibre, the set of the wheels, and the way the body surface changes value as the light crosses it.
